newsitem.title: GREECE: Industrials lift Greek shares 2.03pct to new highs.
newsitem.headline: Industrials lift Greek shares 2.03pct to new highs.

text.p: A strong show by industrial blue chips and middle caps along with banks lifted the Athens benchmark index to new year highs on Wednesday after a dull start.
The Athens bourse's benchmark index leaped 2.03 percent or 32.55 points forward to 1,634.69, from Tuesday's close of 1,602.14, despite early losses in excess of 10 points.
A new year high of 1,636.61 was recorded minutes before session closed.
Industrials charged 4.82 percent with several heavyweight issues, including Hellenic Bottling and Intracom, adding eight percent to their value.
Titan Cement preferred followed suit, though its performance is not monitored by Athens bourse indices.
Banks advanced 1.06 percent and all other sectors registered gains.
Brokers said the rally was supported by improving fundamentals with the 1,600 level having become a strong support level.
"Prices rally in response to positive developments on the macroeconomic and corporate front which are still not fully incorporated," said Giuseppe Giano, general manager at Euroxx Securities.
